Polish powiat boundaries

poland_powiat_boundaries.Rd

Boundaries of the 380 powiats (counties) in Poland, including cities with powiat status, from the 2025 archive of the National Register of Boundaries (Panstwowy Rejestr Granic, PRG).

Usage

poland_powiat_boundaries

Format

Simple features (SF) object containing 380 rows and 4 columns:

jpt_kod_je

Source TERYT territorial unit code.

jpt_nazwa

Powiat name in Polish.

regon

Source REGON identifier, stored as text.

geometry

Simple features multipolygon representing the powiat boundary.

Coordinates use ETRS89 (EPSG:4258), in decimal degrees.

This dataset is also available as a stand-alone file in GeoPackage format at https://mpjashby.github.io/crimemappingdata/poland_powiat_boundaries.gpkg.

Licence: the provider permits PRG data to be used free of charge for any purpose. See the source page for the reuse statement. Credit GUGiK/PRG when redistributing this processed extract.

Source

Head Office of Geodesy and Cartography (GUGiK), National Register of Boundaries (PRG), 2025 archive. https://www.geoportal.gov.pl/pl/dane/panstwowy-rejestr-granic-prg/.
